{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify the QA order: revenue = 999999.99
qa_order = sales[sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99]
print(f'QA order found: {len(qa_order)} row(s)')

# Filter out the QA order and refunded orders
# Keep only completed orders that are not QA
real_completed_orders = sales[(sales['status'] == 'completed') & (sales['revenue_float'] != 999999.99)]
print(f'Number of real completed orders (excluding QA): {len(real_completed_orders)}')

# Compute mean revenue for real completed orders
mean_revenue_real_completed = real_completed_orders['revenue_float'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of real completed orders: {mean_revenue_real_completed}')"}
